description:
Build consistency with a fitness plan that responds to the day you actually have.

microfit.AI combines readiness, full workouts, micro-sessions, nutrition anchors, habits, progress, private on-device coaching, and an optional human trainer network.

ADAPTIVE DAILY PLAN
Check in on energy, sleep, soreness, and stress. Microfit scores readiness and recommends the best match from a stable workout library.

COMPLETE WORKOUT TRACKING
Follow strength, conditioning, balance, and recovery plans with form cues and substitutions. Log sets, reps, load, rest, duration, and effort.

USEFUL IN THREE MINUTES
When the full plan does not fit, choose a timed Desk Reset, Energy Boost, or Calm Down session and keep the streak honest.

PRIVATE COACHING
On compatible iOS 26 devices, Apple’s Foundation Models generate grounded coaching on device. On every other supported device, a complete offline adaptive coach remains available. No prompt or fitness history is sent to a Microfit server.

HUMAN TRAINERS
Browse an owner-reviewed trainer directory, request a one-to-one match, or apply to join the founding network. Requests and applications open as drafts for you to review and send. Your local fitness history is never attached automatically.

FUEL, HABITS, AND PROGRESS
Track protein, fiber, plants, and water without calorie accounting. Build daily habits, earn XP and achievements, and review training history, volume, streaks, and next-step insights.

LOCAL-FIRST BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking. No subscription. Your profile and fitness history stay on your device and can be deleted in the app at any time.

Microfit provides general fitness and wellness guidance, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
promotionalText: Find your next small win with adaptive training, a private on-device coach, and an optional owner-reviewed human trainer network.
whatsNew:
microfit.AI 2.1 adds Human Trainers without giving up the app’s local-first core.

• Browse a curated directory of trainers accepting clients
• Filter profiles by training format and search specialties or location
• Request a one-to-one trainer match with goal, schedule, format, and budget
• Optionally share a basic training-preference summary—off by default
• Apply to join the trainer network with structured credentials and consent
• Review every request or application before sending it through an app you choose
• Clear empty, offline, credential-review, privacy, and payment disclosures
• No account, ads, analytics, tracking, in-app payment, or subscription
